summary: GLM-5.3 (744B) long-context decode up to 12% faster: the DSA indexer picks its merge from the live context length again
compatibility: No user action required. Cached indexer tuning selections are re-planned once.
details: Startup tuning measured the fused-indexer merge at one short length and pinned the serial merge, which is about 3x slower per indexer launch at 128K tokens in the served model.
The tuning space now keeps the automatic per-launch choice (serial below the threshold, cooperative above it); fixed merges remain overrides.
GLM-5.3-NVFP4 TP8 MTP-3 on 8x RTX PRO 6000: C1 70.1 -> 78.3 steps/s at 128K, 74.9 -> 81.9 at 64K, 78.6 -> 83.0 at 32K; C2 111.9 -> 117.6 at 128K; short context unchanged.
